briefdescription.para: Adds redundancy while comparing the return value of called function.

detaileddescription.para: based on NULL == RHS comparison wants to skip some part from execution. This is to avoid glitches from altering the return values of security critical functions. The macro requires a label to be passed to "go to". This MACRO will require when need to strictly check for && as per the implementation.

briefdescription.para: Compute parity of a 32-bit word.
Verify that every bit in MASK reads back clear.

detaileddescription.para:
ADDR
Register address to read.
MASK
Mask of bits expected to be clear.
STATUS
Set to XPM_REG_WRITE_FAILED if any masked bit is set; otherwise left unchanged.
Equivalent to PmChkRegMask32(ADDR, MASK, 0, STATUS) (0 & MASK) != (In32 & MASK) is exactly 0 != (In32 & MASK) but without instantiating the compare-against- a-value macro with a constant value, which leaves a masked-off constant in the comparison and states the intent less directly.
